details: BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes stated on May 5, 2026, that the upcoming US CLARITY Act will have minimal influence on Bitcoin's long-term price trajectory. He argues that global liquidity conditions, potentially increasing due to AI job disruption and geopolitical tensions, are the primary drivers, reiterating his $125,000 Bitcoin price target.
title: Arthur Hayes: CLARITY Act Won't Stop Bitcoin's $125K Ascent

details: On May 4, 2026, a member of the European Central Bank's (ECB) Executive Board delivered a speech discussing the implications of stablecoins and tokenized assets for monetary policy transmission. The speech emphasized the necessity of tokenized central bank money as a risk-free settlement asset and for tokenized assets to be eligible as collateral to foster a robust and scalable digital finance ecosystem.
title: ECB Speech: Digital Assets & Monetary Policy Implications

details: On May 4, 2026, a joint statement was issued by major U.S. banking trade associations, including the Bank Policy Institute, advocating for stronger language in the CLARITY Act to clearly prohibit interest or yield on stablecoins. They assert that yield-earning stablecoins could lead to significant deposit outflows from traditional banks and negatively impact community lending, pointing out a "significant loophole" in the current legislative draft.
title: Banks Urge Stricter Stablecoin Yield Ban in CLARITY Act
